reasons.claim: 4.48 ha regeneration felling notified 2026-10-02. Completed felling overlaps only 1.7% (0.076 ha, from 2026 fellings), so not ALREADY_FELLED.
No records inside or within 250 m, and no eligible species there.

One eligible species, the VU site-bound lichen Alectoria sarmentosa, is recorded 769-918 m away: 9 records, latest 2025, with 10-25 m uncertainty. Threats listed include lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees, and changes in stand structure and tree-species composition. This gives MEDIUM (beyond 250 m, within 1000 m).

Five site-bound forest NT species are recorded at 678-884 m (e.g. Hertelidea botryosa, Phellinidium ferrugineofuscum, Hydnellum ferrugineum). All are beyond 250 m, so they are supporting context only.
Recording effort is low (23 records, 3 observation days, 22nd percentile, county median 66; 0 records within 250 m against a county median of 3), so the empty near-site result is weakly informative.

uncertainties: The lichen records are 770 m or more from the polygon edge and do not show that the species occurs in the stand.
Low effort means near-site absence of records says little. If the site is under-surveyed this could understate what is there.
A small part of the polygon (1.7%) overlaps fellings dated 2026, which does not change the triage.
not_established: Whether any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
The stand's age, structure or habitat value.
Whether the lichen habitat extends toward the polygon.
Anything about sensitive species hidden from public data.
next_action: A reviewer should check whether the stand is continuous with the forest around the 2025 Alectoria sarmentosa records, and consider a field survey, since near-site recording is thin.
